name: documented-skill-contract
description: Renders a validated structured content package into SharePoint modern-page-ready artifacts (an HTML fragment per chunk plus a page-manifest.json) for the confirmed-working Add-PnPPage/Add-PnPPageTextPart route. Does not upload to SharePoint, does not attempt raw .aspx file upload (confirmed Access denied), and does not extract source documents or determine topic boundaries.
prompt: Use the render-sharepoint-pages skill according to its SKILL.md. State the expected inputs, outputs, safety boundaries, and what the skill must not do.
expected: Uses the skill documented in SKILL.md
Identifies the required input artifacts or parameters
Identifies the expected output or report artifact
Respects the documented plugin boundaries and non-responsibilities
Does not invent destructive tenant writes or bypass required confirmation gates
